ELECTRICITY — MOCK EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Cells and Batteries, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Cells and Batteries.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cells and Batteries.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cells and Batteries.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cells and Batteries.

2. When learning Pictorial Drawings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Remove all guards
